baseline_reference: Fable Part 2/Part 3 design note supplied by user; NotebookLM remains INTERNAL_USAGE_NOTE only.

items.fable_expectation: Three-plane separation: Part 1 public authority, Part 2 private documentary workflow, Part 3 operational timeline/CRM, with intent routing and live recompute.
items.current_pr11: Part 1/2/3 separation exists in matter-advice, private forms are separate from public authority, and context-awareness validators cover Part 1/2/3 boundaries.
items.gap: No full matter-store-backed live recompute engine or persisted amendment model yet.
items.next_action: Keep current separation; defer richer matter-store recompute until real private source lane is available.

items.fable_expectation: Separate public authority, private form store, private NotebookLM notes, matter store, and workflow SOP store with strict provenance.
items.current_pr11: Private stores, gitignored private paths, provenance labels, classification review queues, and metadata-only reports exist.
items.gap: Runtime matter store and full SOP store are still represented by fixtures/rules rather than a persistent product store.
items.next_action: Do not expand fixture-only stores; wait for private source availability and reviewer/storage design.

items.fable_expectation: Structured filters first, blockers second, semantic/Qdrant retrieval only inside surviving candidates, private tenant/workspace collections.
items.current_pr11: Private Qdrant contract, collection naming, tenant/workspace filters, disabled-by-default API mode, local/offline embeddings, and filter-first validators exist.
items.gap: Real private Atkin chunks are not indexed because source files are absent; Qdrant execution remains a dry-run contract.
items.next_action: Run real metadata-only ingestion/indexing only after private_uploads/atkin_forms contains source files.

items.fable_expectation: NotebookLM exports parse into form usage notes and scenario expectations, compare backend outputs, and report mismatches without runtime authority.
items.current_pr11: NotebookLM is INTERNAL_USAGE_NOTE, non-authority, non-runtime, non-activating; cross-check reports exist.
items.gap: Exact export contract and JSON schemas were missing before this pass; no private exported notes are present.

items.fable_expectation: Recommended, blocked, placeholder-only, missing-fact/evidence, clause suggestions, review gates, and provenance-rich outputs.
items.current_pr11: Part 2 documentary flow has recommended documents, placeholder-only documents, missing facts/evidence, reviewed-only recall, and no private text committed.
items.gap: Full Fable schema fields such as detailed blocked-document alternatives and notebook cross-check annotations are not complete across all lanes.
items.next_action: Avoid broadening until source availability gate clears.

items.fable_expectation: Generated timeline rows with dependencies, owners, status, due-date basis, amendment overlay, and CRM export.
items.current_pr11: Workflow timeline and CRM export preview exist for metadata-only lanes.
items.gap: Amendment overlay, stable row replay, detached-amendment handling, and source-backed due-date basis are not implemented.
items.next_action: Treat current Part 3 as prototype; do not claim full Fable timeline engine.

items.fable_expectation: Matter facts panel, documentary flow cards, timeline grid, visible intent classification, and live recompute.
items.current_pr11: Existing Fable shell is preserved and forms workspace cards exist.
items.gap: No full three-panel live recompute UI or timeline amendment overlay yet.
items.next_action: Do not redesign viewer in this pass; record UI as partial.

items.fable_expectation: Matter endpoints, fact updates, Part 2 recompute, draft endpoint, timeline/amendment endpoints, review endpoint, export endpoint.
items.current_pr11: Existing /api/forms/recommend modes provide private recall, private Qdrant recall, private framework, matter advice, and workflow timeline without new Vercel functions.
items.gap: No full matter CRUD, amendment API, review-decision API, or production draft endpoint.
items.next_action: Keep current API small while source is absent.

items.fable_expectation: Validators for metadata-only notes, scenario parsing, backend comparison, NotebookLM not authority, wrong-stage blocking, missing facts, private drafts, and separation.
items.current_pr11: The branch has validators covering private text, source gates, NotebookLM non-authority, wrong stage, missing facts, vector blockers, Qdrant tenant filters, Part 1/2/3 boundaries, and draft local-only behavior.
items.gap: Frozen NotebookLM scenario regression is limited by absent exported notes.
items.next_action: Add frozen expectations only after user exports NotebookLM notes.

items.fable_expectation: Committed metadata-only reports for cross-checks, backend comparisons, lane activation, draft rendering, recompute, Part 2/3 completeness, and umbrella status.
items.current_pr11: Umbrella report, private ingestion dry run, Atkin ingestion, Qdrant index, NotebookLM cross-check, context eval, and draft/timeline reports exist.
items.gap: Fable gap audit and source availability gate were missing before this pass.
items.next_action: Use this report as the pre-expansion gate.

items.fable_expectation: Draft rendering only under private_exports with placeholders, provenance, lawyer-only field gates, and finalisation blockers.
items.current_pr11: Local-only private draft renderer and validator exist; reports contain metadata only.
items.gap: Not a deployed drafting endpoint and not backed by real Atkin text in git.
items.next_action: Keep local-only until private store and reviewer permissions exist.

items.fable_expectation: Encrypted private object store, per-firm Qdrant collections, authenticated raw-text fetch, audit logs, reviewer permissions, production store mapping.
items.current_pr11: Qdrant contract and disabled-by-default API mode exist; production private API remains disabled by default.
items.gap: No encrypted private object store, reviewer permission model, raw-text access audit, or production tenant provisioning design is implemented.
items.next_action: Create a separate production private backend design/implementation PR after source and reviewer model are ready.

items.fable_expectation: Actual private source files feed metadata-only ingestion, review queue, private chunks, and Qdrant indexing.
items.current_pr11: private_uploads/atkin_forms is empty; existing report correctly says no local source export was found.
items.gap: Real Atkin ingestion cannot be claimed or run until files are locally available.
items.next_action: Place original source exports under private_uploads/atkin_forms/ and rerun the metadata-only ingestion script.

overall_recommendation: Hold runtime expansion. Complete source export, NotebookLM export, and production private backend design before broadening Part 2/Part 3 beyond the current metadata-only prototype.
